questions.prompt: You run pi inside fleet/data. Which context file comes first in the prompt?
options: The AGENTS.md in the file system root folder
All files are merged with no order
questions.explanation: The global file in ~/.pi/agent/ comes first. Then each parent folder from the root down to the working folder follows.

questions.prompt: A folder holds both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. What does pi load from that folder?
options: Only the first one that exists in its list, AGENTS.md
questions.explanation: In each folder pi takes the first file that exists from its list. AGENTS.md comes before CLAUDE.md.

questions.prompt: Your SQL expert must ignore a general AGENTS.md in your home folder. What do you do?
options: Run pi with --no-context-files and put the knowledge in the pack
Run pi from the root folder
questions.explanation: The flag --no-context-files (-nc) turns the loading off. The expert then gets its knowledge from the pack.
